''See also: [[Vessel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A Vessel is an [[Awakened object]] that serves as a source of power for individuals known as [[Soulbound]]. These objects, which can range from small items like earrings or knives to massive ships, allow their users to harness the abilities of [[Elders]] or [[Kameira]]. The connection between a [[Soulbound]] and their Vessel is deeply personal, often feeling like an extension of the user's own body or a secondary mind. This bond can be complex; [[Vessels]] may possess their own wills, expressing themselves through impulses, impressions, or even mental resistance. While most [[Vessels]] are unobtrusive, some [[Soulbound]] are tied to massive, specialized ships. These Awakened vessels, such as those used by Navigators, are often constructed from seamless, fused wood and may incorporate parts of an Elder to function. Such ships can possess unique characteristics, like the ability to sail without [[wind]] or to move through flames. Because a Vessel is central to a [[Soulbound]]'s power, identifying and destroying it is a primary strategy in combat.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A Vessel serves as a sealable source of power, such as the one [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] seeks to have returned. These objects are bonded to a [[Soulbound]], making it vital to identify which Vessel belongs to a specific individual as quickly as possible. Because a [[Soulbound]] can fight their way to freedom if they are brought back to their Vessel, [[Calder]]'s own Vessel is officially classified as property of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Meanwhile, [[Jerri]] expresses a desire for her Vessel to provide her with protection.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Vessel]] is a source of power that can be sealed.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] possesses a [[Vessel]] that she wishes to have returned.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Soulbound]] bonds a [[Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|It is critical to identify a [[Soulbound]]'s [[Vessel]] quickly.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c21">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A [[Soulbound]] can fight their way free if they are brought to their [[Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Calder]]'s [[Vessel]] is considered property of the [[Aurelian Empire]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c26">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Jerri]] wishes she had her [[Vessel]] to protect herself.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 27</ref>}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|During [[Meia]]'s leap, [[Calder]] experiences a physical sensation as his Vessel tenses. This entity serves as the source of [[Jerri]]'s power, which is delivered to her through [[Kelarac]]. Such a Vessel possesses the ability to transfer power from an object directly into a person's body, though it can also enter a rage with the desire to incinerate its surroundings. Additionally, [[Baldesar Kern]] has been noted to utilize his own Vessel.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] feels his [[Vessel]] tense during [[Meia]]'s leap.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c2">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Vessel]]'s power can flow from an object into a person's body.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c15">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Vessel]] is the source of [[Jerri]]'s power, delivered to her by [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A [[Vessel]] can rage and want to incinerate things.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Baldesar Kern]] mentions using his [[Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
